evidence.title: Remocn - Make a product demo video with your AI agent

name: remocn
summary: shadcn registry of Remotion components — animations, transitions, shaders and app-screen sims for product demo videos.
description: Production-ready Remotion components for building product demo videos: shaders, transitions, effects, UI primitives and AI-tool interface recreations, installed with npx shadcn add. Guides walk through making launch videos, feature announcements and teasers with a coding agent.
contains: 313 installable components in the shadcn registry
shaders: light tunnel, mesh gradient, grain gradient, warp, swirl, water, liquid metal, noise and voronoi
AI interface recreations: ChatGPT, Claude chat, v0, Claude Code, OpenCode and an agent run
UI tier: shadcn primitives (button, input, checkbox, switch, spinner) scripted on the Remotion timeline
guides: launch video, feature announcement, showcase reel, teaser, product demo, changelog video
install with npx shadcn add remocn/
